description: This file defines the class `LineChartRenderer` responsible for rendering line charts within the PdfSharp.Charting library. It includes methods for initialization, layout formatting, and drawing of the line chart, as well as internal methods for setting up series rendering information.

classes.name: LineChartRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class responsible for drawing line charts, inheriting from ColumnLikeChartRenderer, and overriding methods for initialization, formatting, and drawing specific to line charts.

methods.name: LineChartRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with provided parameters.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes renderer-specific info including axes, legend, and plot area.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates the layout and space allocation for the line chart, including axes and plot area.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Handles rendering the entire line chart, including walls, grid lines, axes, legend, and plot area.

methods.name: InitSeriesRendererInfo
methods.description: Prepares rendering info for each data series in the chart.

methods.name: InitSeries
methods.description: Initializes graphical properties for each data series in the chart, including line style and markers.
